mapper.select: SELECT * FROM check_jobs WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND status IN ('queued','running','retry_wait') LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM check_jobs WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND status='success' AND created_at>=#{since} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(attempts),0) FROM check_jobs WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND trigger_type=#{triggerType} AND created_at>=#{since}
SELECT MAX(started_at) FROM check_jobs WHERE user_id=#{userId}
SELECT * FROM check_jobs WHERE status IN ('queued','retry_wait') AND (not_before<=#{now} OR expires_at<=#{now}) ORDER BY not_before,created_at,id LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE check_jobs SET status='running',attempts=attempts+1,started_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('queued','retry_wait')
UPDATE check_jobs SET status='retry_wait',not_before=#{notBefore},last_error=#{message} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='running'
UPDATE check_jobs SET status=#{status},finished_at=#{now},last_error=#{message} WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('queued','running','retry_wait')
UPDATE check_jobs SET status='failure',finished_at=#{now},last_error='定时任务已暂停' WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND trigger_type='scheduled' AND status IN ('queued','retry_wait')
UPDATE check_queue_state SET lease_token=#{token},lease_until=#{leaseUntil} WHERE id=1 AND lease_until<=#{now} AND not_before<=#{now} AND cooldown_until<=#{now}

UPDATE check_queue_state SET lease_token=NULL,lease_until=0,not_before=#{notBefore}, cooldown_until=MAX(cooldown_until,#{cooldownUntil}), transient_failures=CASE WHEN #{transientFailure} THEN transient_failures+1 ELSE 0 END WHERE id=1 AND lease_token=#{token}
